content: ⌊ DRAFT g The diagnostic data element read data length access for a SwCluCDcmProxyDiagnosticData is enabled, if: • SwCluCDcmProxyDataRef references a DcmDspData AND the corresponding DcmDspDid has a DcmDspDidRead configured in its related DcmDspDidInfo AND • the DcmDspDataType is set to UINT8_DYN .
